purpose: Fourteen illustrated 2.5D body proposals for user appearance approval. These are complete artboards, not registered production sprites.

review_panels.requirement: Coherent full-body base view showing the body silhouette, torso volume and limbs.
Same identity, preset and studio pose in fitted high-neck black top, dark pants, gloves and boots with cyan and silver accents.
Same equipped character in an elevated three-quarter orthographic-style illustrated view.

corrections: Male skinny revision 2: reduced elevated-view arm bulk.
Female muscular revision 2: modestly reduced shoulder/arm and leg muscle bulk.
Female fat muscular revision 3: replaced oversized revision 2 with restrained strength cues and soft body contours, following user feedback.
limitations: Static art approval does not prove animation, skin recoloring or interchangeable layers.
Gameplay elevation is an illustrated target; exact camera registration is not verified.

user_feedback.summary: Female muscles should be smaller than corresponding male presets. Fat muscular woman revision 2 had unrealistic oversized arms and legs.
